categories.name: entity-management
categories.description: Entity creation, storage, batching, and termination

customDescriptions.value: Bundle multiple entities into a single composite entity — use for modeling assemblies, kits, or grouped items moving together
Split a composite entity back into individual entities — use for disassembly or unpacking operations in manufacturing or logistics
Model a physical conveyor with transport delay — use for simulating material movement on belts or rollers with spatial dynamics
Pre-built discrete-event design patterns — use as starting templates for common queuing and workflow configurations
Model event-driven logic using Stateflow charts — use for complex state-based entity processing rules that are hard to express with standard blocks
Collect entities into fixed-size batches — use for modeling palletizing, packaging, or batch processing operations
Split a batch entity into individual entities — use for modeling depalletizing or batch unpacking operations
Search for entities matching criteria in a store — use for locating specific items in warehouses or buffers by attribute value
Open or close entity flow based on a signal — use for modeling doors, valves, or conditional access points in entity networks
Create entities at specified rates or times — use for modeling arrivals of customers, parts, or packets entering a system
Route entities from multiple inputs to a single output — use for merging entity streams from parallel paths
Send an entity to all connected outputs simultaneously — use for broadcasting events or duplicating items to multiple destinations
Route entities from a single input to multiple outputs — use for splitting entity flow based on conditions or round-robin logic
Buffer entities in FIFO, LIFO, or priority order — use for modeling waiting lines, buffers, or inventory storage
Create copies of an entity — use for modeling document copying, message broadcasting, or parallel processing splits
Select specific entities from a set based on criteria — use for cherry-picking items from queues or stores by attribute
Process entities with configurable service time — use for modeling workstations, processors, or service desks that hold entities during processing
Store entities in an unordered collection — use for modeling warehouses, parking lots, or pools where order does not matter
Remove entities from the simulation — use for modeling system exits where entities leave permanently
Delay entity flow by a specified time — use for modeling transit time through pipes, corridors, or communication channels
Detect when a signal crosses a threshold — use for triggering discrete events based on continuous signal conditions

Receive messages from Simulink message ports — use for interfacing discrete-event models with message-based Simulink components
Send messages to Simulink message ports — use for triggering Simulink message-based components from discrete-event models
Queue for receiving multicast entity copies — use for buffering broadcast entities at each receiving destination
Acquire shared resources for an entity — use for modeling entities competing for limited resources like machines or operators
Define a pool of shared resources — use for configuring the total supply of machines, workers, or other limited resources
Release previously acquired shared resources — use for freeing resources back to the pool after entity processing completes
Visualize entity and message event sequences — use for debugging event ordering and timing in discrete-event simulations
Debug discrete-event simulations interactively — use for stepping through entity events and inspecting queue states during development
